rules.label: Plastic packaging
rules.localGuidance: Only treat clean, empty plastic packaging as recyclable when it matches the current local collection guidance.

rules.label: Paper and cardboard
rules.localGuidance: Only clean, dry paper and cardboard should match this stream. Used tissues, napkins, paper towels, wet paper, receipts, greasy paper, and food-soiled paper do not match this recyclable paper rule.

rules.label: Metal packaging
rules.localGuidance: Empty and rinse metal packaging before following the current local collection guidance.

rules.label: Glass packaging
rules.localGuidance: Handle glass carefully and follow the current local collection guidance for glass packaging.

rules.label: Batteries and small electronic items
rules.localGuidance: Macau runs a dedicated waste battery collection scheme with more than 1,300 collection points. Batteries must NOT be placed in the ordinary paper, plastic, metal or glass recycling bins. Take them to a battery collection point or the correct programme instead. Some items have more than one channel, and some need preparation before collection.

options.title: Small single-use and rechargeable batteries
options.guidance: Remove the battery from the device first, then drop the battery into a DSPA battery collection box. Boxes are placed at more than 1,300 points across Macau, including schools, shop and institution outlets, residential and commercial buildings, public departments and public refuse rooms.
precautions: Remove the battery from the device before recycling.
Do not mix batteries with ordinary paper, plastic, metal or glass recycling.
options.location: DSPA battery collection boxes across Macau (more than 1,300 points)

options.title: Rechargeable batteries and power banks (Li-ion, Li-polymer, NiMH, NiCd)
options.guidance: Rechargeable batteries and power banks can go into a battery collection box, but the metal contacts and plugs must be covered first to prevent short circuits during storage and transport.
precautions: Tape the metal contacts and all plugs before recycling.
Broken battery: cover the damaged area with tape and seal it inside a plastic bag.
Swollen power bank: tape the plugs and place it in a sealed bag before recycling.
options.location: DSPA battery collection boxes across Macau

options.title: Chargers are not batteries
options.guidance: Chargers are not accepted in the battery collection box. Take chargers to a collection point of the Electronic and Electrical Equipment Recycling Programme.
precautions: Keep chargers separate from loose batteries.
options.location: Electronic and Electrical Equipment Recycling Programme collection points (fixed or mobile)

options.title: Large batteries (car lead-acid, UPS, electric and hybrid vehicle)
options.guidance: Large batteries are collected through the Electronic and Electrical Equipment Recycling Programme. Take them to a mobile collection point or to the programme's pretreatment workshop. There is no charge and no payment for the service.
precautions: Do not put large batteries into a small battery box.
options.location: Mobile collection points, or the Electronic and Electrical Equipment pretreatment workshop, 218 North Frontoft, Taipa, Macau

options.title: Large quantities or institutional collections
options.guidance: Institutions or groups that collect large quantities of waste batteries should contact the DSPA in advance to arrange collection.

rules.label: General waste
rules.localGuidance: Used tissues, napkins, paper towels, wet or greasy paper, food-soiled paper, receipts, and items that cannot be matched to a local recyclable stream should not be placed in a recycling container.

bins.name: Public three-colour recycling bin - plastic bottles
bins.nameZh: 三色資源回收桶 - 膠樽
bins.guidance: Macau's public three-colour recycling bins collect plastic bottles. Empty and rinse the bottle, then remove the cap if local guidance asks.

bins.name: Public three-colour recycling bin - cans
bins.nameZh: 三色資源回收桶 - 鋁罐/鐵罐
bins.guidance: Macau's public three-colour recycling bins collect aluminium and steel cans. Empty and rinse the can.

bins.name: Public three-colour recycling bin - paper
bins.nameZh: 三色資源回收桶 - 紙類
bins.guidance: Macau's public three-colour recycling bins collect paper. Keep it clean and dry, and never add tissues, napkins or food-soiled paper.

bins.name: Public glass bottle recycling bin
bins.guidance: Use a public glass bottle recycling bin. Rinse the bottle and remove the cap and label where possible.

bins.name: Waste battery box or electronic equipment recycling point
bins.nameZh: 廢舊電池收集點 / 電子及電器設備回收點
bins.guidance: Batteries go to a DSPA battery collection box. Chargers, computers and appliances go to the Electronic and Electrical Equipment Recycling Programme. Follow the disposal options and safety notes.

bins.name: Food waste recycling point
bins.guidance: Macau collects household food waste at Eco Fun stations, the mobile recycling truck and the street stations. Bring food waste only where the programme operates.

bins.name: General waste bin - not for recycling
bins.guidance: This item should not go into a recycling bin. Put it in the general waste bin.
